issue.title: Add a MarkUnread notification state update to the sase-core store

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by phase sase-1tz.4.1.6 (wait_blocker) note #3; filed by the sase-1tz.4.1 land agent.

Add a `MarkUnread` state update to sase-core's notification store
(`NotificationStateUpdateWire`) and its Python binding. Today, when a waiter joins a
wait_checks root-blocker notice, the notice flips read -> unread through two reconcile
writes: dismiss with the reversible `wait_checks_auto_dismissed` marker, then resurface.
That happens because the state-update wire has no MarkUnread and reconcile keeps the
on-disk `read` flag (`flip_rows` in `src/sase/scripts/_chop_wait_checks_root_notice.py`).
A core primitive would make it one atomic write, and other senders that need to
resurface a row in place could reuse it.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope:
The epic's wait_blocker phase met its contract with the two-write workaround, which is
correct but not atomic. Adding a store primitive changes the sase-core wire, binding, and
pin, which is beyond that phase's scope, and nothing is broken today.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1tz.4.1.6 needed a two-write dismiss-then-resurface workaround to mark a root-blocker notice unread; the sase-1tz.4.1 land agent is filing its proposed follow-up.
